task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal window showing the contents of fault_log.txt.

task_completion.description: Agent interacts with observatory control software or system tools to diagnose the cascading failures mentioned in the log.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the agent checking status panels, logs, or diagnostic tools related to telescope subsystems.

task_completion.description: Agent performs actions to fix the identified subsystem faults (e.g., restarting services, clearing errors).
task_completion.visual_evidence: GUI interactions such as clicking 'Reset', 'Connect', or 'Initialize' on telescope/camera control panels, or terminal commands resolving service errors.

task_completion.description: Agent commands the telescope to slew to Vega and configures a 10-second V-band exposure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Observatory software showing coordinates near RA 18.6h / Dec +38.7, filter set to 'V', and exposure time set to 10s.

task_completion.description: A test observation image of Vega is saved to the specified verification directory.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file browser or terminal showing a new FITS/image file in ~/Images/verification/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates a detailed fault resolution report at ~/Documents/fault_resolution.txt.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal showing the creation and saving of fault_resolution.txt with content describing the fixes.

integrity.description: The agent used the observatory control GUI rather than just simulating file creation via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots showing the telescope control software interface being manipulated (buttons clicked, fields filled).

integrity.description: The fault resolution report was written after the faults were addressed and the observation was taken.
integrity.visual_evidence: The timestamp or sequence of screenshots shows the report creation as one of the final steps.

integrity.description: The agent manually or programmatically entered the correct coordinates for Vega rather than slewing to a random star.
integrity.visual_evidence: The telescope control GUI showing RA 18h 36m and Dec +38 47' (or decimal equivalents) being entered or active.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target is Vega. Correct coordinates are RA: 18.6156 hours (18h 36m 56.3s) and Dec: +38.7837 degrees (+38° 47' 01.3"). The observation must be 10 seconds in the V-band filter. The verification image must be in /home/ga/Images/verification/ and the report at /home/ga/Documents/fault_resolution.txt.
